metadata.title: Pop Portrait with Rhinestone Heart Lips

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a young woman with fair skin, featuring a central visual hook of lips decorated with pink rhinestones in a heart shape. The composition is tight, with hair partially veiling one side of the face and text placed in the corners.
coreVisualRelationships: The pink heart-shaped lips act as the primary focal point against neutral skin tones.
The diagonal sweep of the hair balances the top-right text block.
The thin, geometric typography mirrors the delicate sparkle of the rhinestones.
coreInvariants: Heart-shaped lip application using pink crystals
Extreme close-up framing focusing on eyes and mouth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and fills the frame; the mouth is positioned in the lower-middle third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pink rhinestone heart on the lips.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the sparkling lips, moves up to the visible eye, then to the top-right text, and finally to the bottom-left text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the face and hair occupy approximately 95% of the frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale peach and cream (skin tones) provide a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown (hair and eyelashes) provides structural depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant candy pink (rhinestones and text) provides the thematic pop.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background with high-saturation, high-value accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to pink, white, brown, and skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal bars in letters like 'E' and 'L'
Inclusion of small heart icons as glyph substitutes or connectors
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Z' features a sharp, elongated diagonal
The ampersand is replaced or modified with a heart-shaped knot

composition.overlap: on top of hair and skin
composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into the upper-right negative space of the hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying scales and slight modifications for icons.
graphicDevices: Small heart icons integrated into text lines
Underlining on specific words to create a baseline

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and thin strokes.
Provides the necessary geometric precision and light weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up of a young woman's face. Her skin is flawless and softly lit. Her lips are decorated with small, sparkling pink rhinestones arranged in a distinct heart shape. Her brown hair falls diagonally across the right side of her face, partially obscuring one eye. The visible eye looks slightly to the side with dark mascara.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-light geometric sans-serif text in the top-right and bottom-left corners. Use a soft pink-to-white gradient for the fill. Ensure the 'O' characters are perfectly circular and the overall weight is hairline. Integrate a small heart icon next to the text.

verificationChecks: Is the lip makeup a clear heart shape made of crystals?
Is the text weight extremely thin and geometric?
Is the lighting soft with no harsh shadows on the face?
Is the hair creating a diagonal division in the frame?

adjustableVariables: Amount of face covered by hair
Intensity of the pink gradient in the text
mustRedesign: Exact placement of the heart icon if it mimics a trademark

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the rhinestone texture

postGenerationChecks: Check that the heart shape on the lips is symmetrical.
Ensure the text is legible despite the hairline weight.
Verify the pink color is consistent between the lips and the typography.
Confirm the hair does not obscure the primary focal point of the mouth.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme close-up portrait + [Specific Rhinestone Shape] on lips + Hairline Geometric Sans-Serif Typography + [Accent Color] Palette.
